scope: Read-only original GitHub workflow/job/log review. No workflow dispatch/retry, local execution, artifact-image download or source mutation. No claim that these separate workflows replace the still-required exact Host Native52/17, Live9/7, Discovery10/38 or Dream5/7/2 acceptance.
failure_marker_scan_note: Explicit failure markers and nonzero failure counts checked. The review filter distinguishes checks=N failures=0 from the natural-language phrase N failures.

evidence_capture.api_response_body_format: The GitHub connector-returned UTF-8 JSON response bodies are preserved verbatim; no JSON reformatting was applied to metadata originals.
evidence_capture.archive_format: Uncompressed POSIX ustar; original member bytes preserved; member timestamps normalized to zero for reproducibility.

limits: These eleven workflows are real newly completed Native PR runs, all attempt1 and bound to e9a9 or its identical-tree PR merge.
The Nextgen visual-smoke workflow is not the complete Native52/17 suite. This evidence does not replace the next exact Host Native52/17, Live9/7, Discovery10/38 or Dream5/7/2 acceptance.
Captured-image counts are facts from original successful workflow logs. This archival review did not download, decode or visually inspect the artifact images.
No new CI dispatch/retry, Godot, renderer, Android or Flutter execution was performed for evidence collection.

Native source-checkout identities are recorded from actual checkout log output and immutable Git commit/tree objects. No additional post-test worktree cleanliness claim is inferred beyond the original workflows.
